newsitem.title: USA: Innovative Tech on target for FY profits.
newsitem.headline: Innovative Tech on target for FY profits.

text.p: Innovative Tech Systems Inc said on Monday it is on target to achieve profitability on revenues of $8 million to $9 million in the fiscal year ending January 1997.
In the year ended January 1996, the company reported revenues of $2.78 million and a loss of $858,174, or $0.07 a share.
Innovative Tech said the launch of the Windows version of its SPAN-FM software has been successful and the company completed its acquisition of Facility Management Systems Inc.
